patterns.name: 连续非负分段：最大化最小段和
patterns.objective: max x: every segment sum>=x
patterns.assumptions: nonnegative, exactly K nonempty, K<=n
patterns.predicate: greedily close at threshold; count>=K
patterns.regression_trap: [3,3,-3],T=3,K=2 invalidates greedy count without nonnegativity
patterns.decision: LC1231 statement locked; original-pattern derivation requires constraint citation

patterns.name: 预算抬升目标值
patterns.objective: max target with minimum cost<=budget
patterns.assumptions: CF1201C odd n; increment one element per operation
patterns.predicate: sort, sum max(0,target-a[i]) over upper half
patterns.regression_trap: must justify which half is cheapest; 64-bit cost
patterns.decision: leveling greedy is a preferable direct alternative when naturally understood

patterns.name: 固定操作前缀后的状态
patterns.objective: last feasible deletion prefix / first feasible addition prefix
patterns.assumptions: operations have one-direction effect and fixed order
patterns.predicate: timestamp array plus actual subsequence or interval-coverage checker
patterns.regression_trap: arbitrary restores/replacements do not preserve monotonicity
patterns.decision: two checker variants under one family; RMQ of earliest nail time can eliminate outer binary

patterns.name: 平均值/中位数变换与合法最小前缀
patterns.objective: max average or lower median among subarrays length>=L
patterns.assumptions: must preserve length conditions and median convention
patterns.predicate: average subtract x then >=0; lower-median +/-1 then >0; eligible minimum prefix
patterns.complexity: O(n log R) or O(n log(R/eps))
patterns.regression_trap: [1,2],x=2 lower median requires strict >0; max length adds deque window
patterns.decision: same prefix mechanism, distinct mapping/comparison; retain both

patterns.name: 瓶颈路径阈值可达
patterns.objective: min threshold permitting s->t
patterns.assumptions: edge threshold LC1631 vs vertex threshold LC778
patterns.predicate: BFS/DFS on filtered graph
patterns.regression_trap: LC778 must test source eligibility, unlike edge-difference check
patterns.decision: graph chapter should foreground minimax Dijkstra/DSU as alternatives

patterns.name: 阈值筛选后的非邻接数量
patterns.objective: min capability with >=K houses
patterns.assumptions: unweighted selection on a path, eligible nums[i]<=T
patterns.predicate: take earliest eligible and skip adjacent
patterns.regression_trap: arbitrary graph independent set or weighted benefit needs different checker
patterns.decision: not just copy sum-max House Robber DP

patterns.name: 数量二分与带资源匹配
patterns.objective: max assignable tasks
patterns.assumptions: uniform pill boost; one task per worker; one pill per worker
patterns.predicate: easiest K tasks / strongest K workers; hardest first; strongest if no pill else weakest viable boosted
patterns.complexity: O(n log n+m log m+K log K log min(n,m))
patterns.regression_trap: tasks[6,8],workers[5,7],pill1,boost3: strongest-pill greedy fails
patterns.decision: deque O(K) checker candidate not yet verified

patterns.name: 区间任务容量可行性
patterns.objective: min per-slot capacity
patterns.assumptions: groups A_i have interval destinations; A_i may be 1e9
patterns.predicate: left-to-right earliest deadline heap with batched counts
patterns.regression_trap: never loop per passenger; expired remaining group is failure
patterns.decision: autonomous derivation, editorial method unavailable; verify with small max-flow

patterns.name: 等长区间覆盖/带容量分组
patterns.objective: min radius or time span
patterns.assumptions: sorted points; coverage intervals or group size limit
patterns.predicate: cover leftmost point as far right as possible; add count cap for buses
patterns.regression_trap: coverage center need not be an input point; 2R interval not R
patterns.decision: merge the short variants; not same as selected-point spacing

patterns.name: 可用区间中最大化最小间距
patterns.objective: max D allowing N integer points
patterns.assumptions: disjoint intervals, coordinates to 1e18, D>0
patterns.predicate: place earliest legal points; batch arithmetic per interval possible
patterns.complexity: O((N+M) log R); O(M log R) batched
patterns.regression_trap: cannot enumerate all integer coordinates; large boundary/last+D
patterns.decision: important condition variant of existing finite-point spacing

patterns.name: 带折返成本的线性行走覆盖
patterns.objective: min T covering targets by ordered agents
patterns.assumptions: line, unit speed, targets visited free, agents do not interfere
patterns.predicate: leftmost uncovered target; reach p+max(T-2d,(T-d)/2) if left detour d
patterns.complexity: O(n log n) in strip length bound
patterns.regression_trap: [p-T,p+T] radius falsely ignores time to visit both sides
patterns.decision: retains implementation-changing checker

patterns.name: 资源数二分与事件堆模拟
patterns.objective: min parallel slots completing by deadline
patterns.assumptions: fixed task order; next starts on first completion
patterns.predicate: heap of completion times
patterns.regression_trap: not arbitrary optimal multiprocessor scheduling and not independent-machine floor count
patterns.decision: official analysis read

patterns.name: 周期扰动与可达距离
patterns.objective: min feasible time
patterns.assumptions: unit wind each day; unit self move or stay
patterns.predicate: prefix displacement + cycle; Manhattan(target-natural_position)<=time
patterns.regression_trap: unreachable instances exist; doubling without cap may overflow
patterns.decision: use exact problem-specific monotonicity

patterns.name: 预算消元/连续时间的区间交
patterns.objective: min budget/time with nonempty feasible intersection
patterns.assumptions: positive speeds; or bounded positive integer final times
patterns.predicate: intersect reachable intervals; Bakery eliminates y using fixed x+y
patterns.regression_trap: signed ceil/floor division; zero coefficient; correct integer vs real feasibility
patterns.decision: one clean interval-intersection family with distinct numeric contracts

patterns.name: 整除值不变段批量模拟
patterns.objective: max policy parameter repaying in K days
patterns.assumptions: N,K,M<=1e12; repayment max(floor(remaining/X),M)
patterns.predicate: skip all days with same quotient; finish minimum-payment phase directly
patterns.regression_trap: O(K) simulation remains infeasible despite binary outer loop
patterns.decision: integer arithmetic/simulation main placement; not core long template

patterns.name: 含负数乘积的排名计数
patterns.objective: first x count(products<=x)>=K
patterns.assumptions: sorted signed inputs; products to 1e10
patterns.predicate: positive rows ascending, negative rows descending, zero all-or-none
patterns.complexity: O(n log m log W), optimized O((n+m) log W)
patterns.regression_trap: C++ truncating division cannot stand in for floor/ceil; count needs 64-bit
patterns.decision: merge under implicit order statistics but code is materially different

patterns.name: 排名门槛后聚合前K项
patterns.objective: sum top M implicit pair sums
patterns.assumptions: ordered pairs distinct, diagonal allowed; M<=n²
patterns.predicate: count+sum pairs>=T; remove (count-M)*T boundary duplicates
patterns.complexity: O(n log n log W); two pointers O(n log W)
patterns.regression_trap: finding threshold alone not the answer; count ordered pairs correctly
patterns.decision: extension of rank inversion with essential duplicate correction

patterns.name: 鸽巢计数定位唯一重复值
patterns.objective: locate only duplicated value with O(1) memory
patterns.assumptions: n+1 entries in[1,n], only one repeated distinct number
patterns.predicate: count(values<=x)>x
patterns.regression_trap: multiple duplicate values break monotonicity: [1,1,4,4,4,5]
patterns.decision: Floyd O(n) should be primary solution

patterns.name: 树上最大最小分量规模
patterns.objective: max T allowing exactly K edge removals
patterns.assumptions: tree with unit positive vertex sizes
patterns.predicate: postorder gather, collect subtree once size>=T; groups>=K+1
patterns.regression_trap: root leftover can merge back; no recursion-stack assumption for 1e5 chain
patterns.decision: tree greedy/DFS primary home absent so unresolved carriage

patterns.name: 非负矩阵边长与二维前缀
patterns.objective: max square side with sum<=threshold
patterns.assumptions: nonnegative entries
patterns.predicate: 2D prefix sum scan all squares for fixed side
patterns.regression_trap: negative entries break length monotonicity
patterns.decision: grow current best only gives O(mn), preferable primary

patterns.name: 向左搬运的前缀容量
patterns.objective: min maximum after leftward transfers
patterns.assumptions: nonnegative integer array, moves only left
patterns.predicate: max ceil(prefixSum/prefixLength)
patterns.regression_trap: generic min-max wording does not require binary search
patterns.decision: prefix invariant is main lesson

patterns.name: 衰减连锁覆盖
patterns.objective: min initial blast power
patterns.assumptions: line, later radius decreases by1, half-integer answer
patterns.predicate: official two-direction DP/greedy and crossover scan
patterns.complexity: O(n log n) sorting then near-linear scan
patterns.regression_trap: same title as Silver Angry Cows but different dynamics
patterns.decision: better main solution than nested binary; scale coordinates by2

patterns.name: 图构造公式的交叉点
patterns.objective: max edges with at least half bridges
patterns.assumptions: simple undirected graph; n<=2e9
patterns.predicate: core vertex count k; compare min(C(k,2),n-k)+(n-k) around crossover
patterns.complexity: O(log n) per query once proven
patterns.regression_trap: objective itself not monotone; official tutorial text unavailable
patterns.decision: retain as math/graph proof gap; comment not authority

patterns.name: 直线道路的圆覆盖/距离下包络
patterns.objective: max over road of nearest-base distance
patterns.assumptions: N<=1e6, sorted x, 2D base locations
patterns.predicate: fixed radius gives road intervals; union covers road iff radius sufficient
patterns.complexity: naive sort each check O(n log n log eps); optimal unresolved
patterns.regression_trap: center x sorted does not imply interval endpoint sorted
patterns.decision: geometry/stack envelope needed before claim full solution

patterns.name: 交互前缀计数排名
patterns.objective: find kth zero with <=20 sum queries
patterns.assumptions: F1 one query, n<=2e5
patterns.predicate: zeros(1..mid)=mid-ones; first >=k
patterns.regression_trap: flush and error response are real interface requirements, not a new static search algorithm
patterns.decision: short cross reference; F2 not read

patterns.name: TripTastic
patterns.predicate: official page only JS shell
patterns.decision: do not infer algorithm from source tag
